title: POST /intake/submissions request
description: Submit (or re-submit, keyed by externalId per client) a client-voiced draft to the firm. Tolerant reader: receivers MUST ignore properties they do not know; additionalProperties is therefore never false in this contract.

externalId.description: Portal document id — the idempotency key per client.

client.description: The portal identity. email or name is required on first contact.

matterType.description: Portal matter-pack code. INFORMATIONAL ONLY: stored and displayed, never drives BigLaw behaviour.

jurisdiction.description: BCP-47-style region tag, e.g. US-CA, CA-ON.

practiceArea.description: Optional. A BigLaw canonical practice area matches case-insensitively; anything else is kept as free text after NOSLEGAL areaOfLaw.

adverseParties.description: Parties on the other side. adverse_party facts are also treated as adverse parties.

metadata.description: Stored verbatim (≤ 16 KiB serialized); never interpreted.
